values.content:
=You are a brand SERP strategist. Analyse these Google search results for '{{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}' and identify gaps.

Search results:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.organic_results, null, 2) }}

Knowledge panel present: {{ $json.knowledge_graph ? 'YES' : 'NO' }}
Map pack present: {{ $json.local_results ? 'YES' : 'NO' }}

Target assets for SERP ownership:
- Position 1: Official website (organic)
- Position 2-3: Inner pages (About, Services, Blog)
- Knowledge Panel: Google Knowledge Graph card
- Map Pack: Google Business Profile (3-pack)
- Position 4: YouTube channel or video
- Position 5: LinkedIn company page
- Position 6: Facebook business page
- Position 7: Instagram profile
- Position 8: Press article or news mention
- Position 9: Industry directory (TrueLocal, Yellow Pages, HiPages)
- Position 10: Reddit, Quora, or community mention

For EACH gap (position not owned by the business), provide:
1. asset_to_create: What needs to be built/claimed
2. platform: Which platform
3. priority: high/medium/low
4. estimated_time_to_index: days
5. auto_buildable: true/false (can n8n + Claude create it automatically?)
6. action: Exact action to take
7. content_needed: Brief description of content required

Also provide:
- overall_serp_score: X/10 (positions owned)
- knowledge_panel_status: present/absent/partial
- top_priority_fix: The single most impactful gap to fix this week

Return as JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — SERP Gap Analysis
nodes.notes: Claude analyses which of the 10 page-1 positions are not owned by the business and generates a fix plan for each

nodes.name: YouTube Gap?
nodes.notes: Routes to YouTube channel creation flow if YouTube is missing from SERP

values.content:
=Write a complete YouTube channel setup package for:

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
City: {{ $('load-config').item.json.city }}

Generate:
1. channel_name: Best YouTube channel name (business name + optional descriptor)
2. channel_description: 500 word channel description, keyword-optimised for YouTube search
3. channel_keywords: 20 tags for the channel
4. intro_video_script: 90-second intro video script. Structure: hook (0-5s), who we are (5-30s), what we do (30-60s), social proof (60-75s), CTA (75-90s). Include b-roll directions in [brackets].
5. first_3_video_titles: SEO-optimised titles targeting '[service] [city]' keyword structure
6. first_3_video_descriptions: 300-word descriptions per video, with timestamps and keyword-rich text
7. playlist_names: 5 playlist names that organise content by topic
8. channel_art_brief: 150-word design brief for channel banner art (for Canva)

Return as JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — YouTube Channel Package
nodes.notes: Generates complete YouTube channel setup: description, keywords, scripts for first 3 videos, playlist structure

values.content:
=Write a complete press release for distribution to Australian news sites and PR newswire services.

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
City: {{ $('load-config').item.json.city }}

Angle: Business milestone / expansion / new service / community involvement (choose the most newsworthy angle for this industry).

Format:
- Headline (60 chars max, newsworthy)
- Subheadline (120 chars)
- Dateline: [City], Australia — [today's date]
- Lead paragraph (50 words, covers who/what/where/when/why)
- Body (3 paragraphs, 100 words each)
- Quote from business owner (authentic, not corporate-speak)
- Boilerplate (100 words about the business, evergreen)
- Contact details section

Also generate:
- distribution_targets: 5 Australian PR distribution sites to submit to
- seo_anchor_text: 3 keyword-rich anchor text phrases for backlinks in the release
- social_share_caption: Instagram/Facebook caption announcing the press release

Return as JSON with field 'press_release_html' containing the full release in clean HTML.
